item.title: About
item.description: Hi, I’m Michał I’m a Senior Unity Developer and Tech Lead with 10+ years of experience shipping games and interactive applications across PC, console, mobile, and XR. I hold the Unity Certified Expert Programmer credential and have spent the last several years leading teams and owning architecture on production-scale projects — most recently as Tech Lead on a live MMO with 50+ engineers. I care about scalable systems, clean code, and shipping things that actually work.
